headline: The public status page had reported our edge as degraded on 604 consecutive samples while the site served every visitor — a Cloudflare bot challenge read as an outage.

items.title: Unobservable is now a state, not a false outage
items.insight: Cloudflare widened bot challenges to JSON and OPTIONS paths, falsifying the premise the probe was rewritten on. Each API leg read its own challenge as an outage. A challenged leg is now neither an outage nor a pass — promoting it to ok would be the same lie with the opposite sign and would blind the probe to the real outage it exists to catch.
items.evidence: Live probe: 200 residential vs 403/127ms from CI; 62/62 probe self-tests (was ~43) incl. a negative control; new state carried to the contract gate, the public tile, rollup denominators and history rows in the same session

items.title: An alarm that was structurally incapable of firing
items.insight: edgeHtmlBroken guarded on !liveness.ok, which was permanently true while challenged. The one apex-HTML failure shape the probe exists to page on could not have fired once in the entire 59-day window. Found only while repairing the liveness leg.
items.evidence: Guard re-expressed as observably-down; self-tests pin both directions

items.title: Observe the edge from inside the edge — shipped dark
items.insight: A Cloudflare cron is never bot-challenged, so it is the only vantage that can ever observe our edge. Ships behind a flag that is off, with no KV binding and no cron trigger, so the deploy is provably inert; enabling it is its own release with a flag-flip rollback.
items.evidence: 5 unit tests assert zero KV writes and zero subrequests while off; bounded one-key-per-window KV with TTL; no subrequest to any hostname on our own routes

items.title: The service worker was evicting its own offline shell
items.insight: Navigations shared a cache with the install precache, and the LRU deletes keys[0] — the first entry ever written, which is '/'. Past 60 entries every navigation deleted a precached shell asset in order. activate() also destroyed the API cache on every single activation.
items.evidence: Separate PAGE_CACHE; version-prefixed keep-set in activate; 119/119 unit tests

items.title: Keyboard skip link was unreachable before the stylesheet swapped
items.insight: The :focus reveal lived only in the async-loaded stylesheet, so a keyboard user tabbing before the swap focused a link parked at top:-100%. A WCAG 2.4.7 failure on every shell page for the whole pre-swap window.
items.evidence: Fixed in the critical-shell generator; 108/108 pages carry it, 0 unpatched

items.title: The gateway now reads the disproof it already held
items.insight: check-secrets printed READY for supabase.admin while the same map entry recorded lastProbeStatus auth-error — on the surface an agent checks before declaring itself blocked. Surfaced a second unknown failure nobody had seen: openai.api unreachable.
items.evidence: Honest ready count 44/72 rather than 46/72; exit codes unchanged so a failing probe cannot become a phantom blocker

followUps: Enable the edge sampler as its own release: create the KV namespace, uncomment the binding and cron, flip the flag, verify with drain-uptime-kv --dry-run.
Visibility-gated teardown for four uncancellable client polling timers verified this session (desk-presence, favicon-pulse, vault-pulse).
Prune six superseded hashed shell assets that are tracked and publicly servable.
Three public pages skip a heading level (h1 to h3).
blockers: Edge liveness is honestly UNMEASURED, not fixed — the sampler that can observe it ships dark and has never run. Its presence is not coverage.
604 pre-S349 uptime rows are unresolvable; they are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.

honestyLedger.title: Unobservable is not a pass
honestyLedger.why: The obvious fix — treat 403 as fine — would have laundered a blind leg into a green and blinded the probe to the real outage. edge-unobservable is neither.

honestyLedger.title: History is labelled, never re-scored
honestyLedger.why: 604 legacy rows carry the challenge footprint but not the shape, so they cannot be told apart from a real outage after the fact. Re-scoring them would improve a public number using a judgement the data cannot support.

honestyLedger.title: The sampler is not claimed to work
honestyLedger.why: It has never run. The flag is off, the KV namespace does not exist and the cron is commented out; only the inertness is tested.

honestyLedger.title: A failing probe is not an absent credential
honestyLedger.why: check-secrets exit codes were left unchanged so a wrapper cannot fold a failing probe into the human-blocked label CANON-019 forbids.

honestyLedger.title: Measured locally, not against production
honestyLedger.why: The mobile matrix ran against a local preview; production would have measured the pre-change pages and passed for the wrong reason.

diffStat.suite: 479/479 build steps exit 0 from a frozen tree
